title: a Wonder asks who is in and who will help

criteria.text: A Wonder is a post kind on a Page the member manages: words, a threshold (a whole number), and an optional list of sizes or options the poster names
criteria.note: Built by #1081 (merged 10-26): `page_posts.kind` ('announcement' | 'wonder'), `wonder_threshold` (1 to 1,000,000) and `wonder_options` (1 to 12) with a shape check, `group.post_create` taking `wonder: { threshold, options }`, and a 'Make it a Wonder' switch in the Page composer [V migration 20261025120000, post.ts, PagePosts.tsx]. Checked: `[guards F117.1]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts`: the row's kind, threshold and sizes, a non-manager refused, 2.5 and 0 refused, a raw insert without a threshold refused; `PagePosts.test.tsx` adds a `partial` for the composer; each seen failing first per the PR body [V]. Reviewed: #1081 is `review-skipped` and has no GitHub review; its visibility review is the builder's own. Shipped: Deploy health green on dc65fac; the migration applied on the branch at 16:43 before the 16:44 merge [V run list]. Smoked: smoke-live opened `page` green for every persona on 10-26 (on dc65fac) and 10-27, a load check of the first Page on Explore, which carries no Wonder [V].

criteria.text: I'm in: any signed-in member can join once, picking one size when the Wonder has sizes; they can change their size or leave
criteria.note: `wonder.join` upserts one `wonder_interest` row per (post, member), refuses a missing or unknown size when the Wonder has sizes, `wonder.leave` deletes it; the count on the post is rewritten in the same transaction; a signed-out caller is refused [V wonder.ts]. The panel's 'I'm in' sheet with size radios, 'Change size' and 'Leave' [V WonderPanel.tsx]. Checked: `[guards F117.2]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` (join without a size, an unknown size, join, change, a Wonder with no sizes, leave twice, signed out); `WonderPanel.test.tsx` adds a `partial` for the sheet [V]. Reviewed: no (#1081 review-skipped). Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: Progress bar: the Wonder shows the count of members in and the threshold as a bar, to anyone who can see the post; it reads full at the threshold and keeps counting past it
criteria.note: `wonder_in_count` and `wonder_threshold` ride on the post row; `wonder_view` returns total and threshold to anyone signed in who can read the post; the panel renders a `progressbar` capped at 100% with 'Goal reached. Still counting.' past the threshold [V migration, WonderPanel.tsx]. Checked: `[guards F117.3]` twice: `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` (four in on a threshold of three reach a non-poster and the row; signed out gets null) and `WonderPanel.test.tsx` (120, 500 and 612 of 500) [V]. Signed-out readers get no view at all, which is the post's own visibility rule, not a gap. Reviewed: no. Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: Size split: the poster sees the count per size; others see only the total
criteria.note: `wonder_view` adds `byOption` only when the caller manages the Page; the panel shows 'By size' to managers only [V]. 'The poster' means the Page's managers, decided in #1081 by the decision rule. Checked: `[guards F117.4]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` (the manager's per-size counts, a member's view without them); `WonderPanel.test.tsx` adds a `partial` that a visitor sees no split [V]. Reviewed: no. Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: I can help as: any signed-in member can offer one or more of the eight roles (lead, designer, pattern-maker or sampler, sourcing, quality, logistics, support, treasurer), with an optional one-line note
criteria.note: `wonder.offer` writes one `wonder_offers` row per role from the eight in `WONDER_ROLES`, the same list in the table's check, note up to 140 characters; the panel's 'I can help' sheet lists the eight as checkboxes with a note field [V roles.ts, migration, WonderPanel.tsx]. Checked: `[guards F117.5]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` (two roles with a note, a repeat kept, all eight accepted, a ninth role, an empty list, a 141-character note and a signed-out caller refused); `WonderPanel.test.tsx` adds a `partial` for the sheet [V]. Reviewed: no. Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: Accepting a helper: the poster accepts or declines each offer; accepted helpers show on the Wonder by display name and role; pending and declined offers are seen only by the poster and the person who offered
criteria.note: `wonder.offer_decide` (managers only) sets accepted or declined; `wonder_view` gives everyone the accepted helpers by display name and role, the caller their own offers, and managers every offer; RLS on `wonder_offers` lets only the offerer or a manager select a row [V wonder.ts, migration]. Checked: `[guards F117.6]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` (a non-manager refused, accept and decline, what a third member, the offerer and the manager each see, the table as each role, anon refused, withdraw only by its owner); `WonderPanel.test.tsx` adds a `partial` for Accept [V]. Reviewed: no. Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: Privacy: nobody sees who is in except the poster, who sees names and sizes; a member's own state is visible to them
criteria.note: RLS on `wonder_interest` lets only the row's member or a Page manager select it; anon has no grant; `wonder_view` adds `people` (name and size) only for managers and `mine` for the caller; names reach anyone only as display names, never member ids [V migration]. Checked: `[guards F117.7]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts`, a standing guard on the live schema: the manager's names and sizes, a member's own row and nothing else through the view and the table, a third member seeing nothing, anon refused, and a dissolved Wonder answering nobody [V]. Reviewed: no. Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: Reports: a Wonder is reportable like any post
criteria.note: A Wonder is a `page_posts` row, so the post card's 'Report this post' control (F078) and `report.create` with `subjectKind: 'post'` cover it unchanged [V PagePosts.tsx:695, migration comment]. Checked: `[guards F117.8]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts` files a report on the Wonder through `reportCreate` [V]. Reviewed: no. Shipped: dc65fac green. Smoked: `page` green 10-26 and 10-27, load check only.

criteria.text: No money: nothing on a Wonder takes, holds or promises payment
criteria.note: No price, pledge or payment column, call or string: the handlers, the panel, the server actions and the Wonder copy carry none, and the composer note says 'No money changes hands.' [V grep src/actions/wonder, src/components/wonders, src/app/_actions/wonder-actions.ts, copy.ts]. Checked: `[guards F117.9]` in `tests/wonders-db.test.ts`, a standing guard: every column on `wonder_interest`, `wonder_offers` and the `wonder*` columns of `page_posts`, and the wonders migration's code, scanned for price, amount, cents, pledge, payment, paid, fee, stripe, money, budget and payout [V]. The guard reads the schema and the migration, not `src`; today's grep of `src` is clean.
